newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign funds use hits $51 billion in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China foreign funds use hits $51 billion in 1996.

text.p: China used $51 billion worth of foreign funds in 1996, including $40 billion of overseas investment and $11 billion in loans, a State Planning Commission official said on Friday.

The official did not give comparative figures, but said foreign investment was troubled by indiscriminate signing of joint ventures and too few funds going to the energy, farming, transportation and raw materials sectors.
Some foreign loans had not been used efficiently, with the construction of many projects falling behind schedule, the official said by telephone.

China had planned to give 70 percent of the foreign loans to projects in its poorer central and western regions last year but many funds had gone to booming coastal areas instead because of that area's greater profitability, he said but gave no details.
